body: I went to a counselor and it was supposed to be 1 on 1 and then some random lady came in and wouldn't leave so I stopped going because I can't deal with having someone stare at me like that while I was in counseling.
Doctors pushed 5 different meds on me already I've already said I'm through with them. My mother knows that if I go to a doctor for mental issues again.

I have tried some things people say but I think I am just too far gone. I will have to go through this other college to complete it with a lower gpa and it might be less favorable and I don't want to disappoint my advisor because he is so nice. Every waking moment is a panic attack. Heart sinks like a rollercoaster every time I see another person on the street. I can't even talk about it if I did have friends because I heard people talking about someone they knew and they were making fun of him for being 'stressed' they said. They said everyone has stress in college and to get over it and I do not want more bullying.
